notes.primary_contrast: minmax minus standard; negative MSE differences mean improvement
notes.other_contrasts: minmax_clip and raw are diagnostic arms, not test-selected replacements
notes.selection: Within each arm, family, seed, and (for PenDigits) coordinate, minimize validation MSE averaged across horizons. Main campaign uses original stable first-minimum tie behavior; other campaigns use feature count then name as tiebreaks.
notes.primary_outcome: Arithmetic mean of test MSE across horizons and fitting seeds, reported separately per task. No cross-generator physical-error average is asserted.
notes.rmse_summary: Per-horizon mean and sample SD of replicate RMSE; PenDigits pools coordinate MSE before the square root.
notes.synthetic_intervals: Unadjusted approximate normal 95% intervals for paired mean test-loss differences, conditional on the fitted, validation-selected models. They are descriptive Monte Carlo uncertainty, not the manuscript's finite-sample certificates, and do not include training randomness.
notes.seed_variation: All seed effect signs and sample SDs are retained. A separate seed SD summarizes complete-learning variation; it is not interchangeable with the conditional episode standard error.
notes.pendigits: Equal-weighted eligible writers in the fixed held-out cohort; average coordinate MSE before RMSE. Writer differences are descriptive. No iid-writer population interval is computed. Repeated fitting seeds share the same test cohort.
notes.audit: Original baseline replay and non-KAHM invariance exclude only timing fields. Both exact equality and tolerance agreement are recorded; maximum discrepancies are retained by metric.

record.repair_method: Exact replay of the same frozen confirmation job; only artifact output destination changed. No hyperparameters, seeds, preprocessing, data, or selection changed.
